item.title: Orion Beer Guide: Brewery Tour, Tasting & Access (Nago)
item.description: Orion Beer is Okinawa’s hometown brew — a crisp, easy-drinking lager designed for the island’s heat and humidity, and a fixture of every izakaya table and beach barbecue. Founded in Nago in 1957, Orion is a beloved symbol of Okinawan identity. At the Nago brewery (Orion Happy Park) you can tour the production line and reward yourself with a glass of ultra-fresh draft straight from the source — a fun, family-friendly stop in northern Okinawa, often combined with the aquarium.
